api:
OV.Act (js/sim/battle/actions.js):
- reserveTU(B, u, opts?) → int. opts is {mode, noKneel, standing}. With standing:true the kneel TU are counted even when the unit is kneeling now. V.walk, P.walk and walkPreview always pass standing:true.
- validate(B, {type:'shoot'}) with a guided weapon (def.guided, the Blaster Launcher) → {ok:true, …, route:[tileIdx from … to]} (from Path.flyRoute), or {ok:false, reason:'noRoute', key:'bs.noRoute'}. Other weapons: route:null, and the noLOF rule is unchanged. REASONS gains 'noRoute'.
- P.shoot: a shot fired from a dark tile adds a muzzle flash, B.flashes.push({i, side}). Light and LOS are refreshed and 'spotted' events are yielded.

OV.Battle (battle.js):
- B.flashes = [] in create(). It is included in hash().
- sideStart(side) removes that side's flashes.
- beginBattle: aliens killed by the power-source blasts get u.crashDead = true, stats.crashDead++ and stats.aliensKilled--.

OV.LOS.computeLight: B.flashes are light sources with power TUNE.MUZZLE_FLASH_LIGHT, and they are part of dynamicSig.

OV.AI.explosivePlan:
- On an alien, a grenade is primed with fuse TUNE.AI_GRENADE_FUSE[difficulty] ([1,0,0]).
- An alien fires the Blaster bomb only with a line of fire (targetVoxel).

OV.BaseSim (geo/base.js):
- sellCraft(G, craftId) → {ok, price, rent} | {ok:false, reason}. rent is added to base.rentDue.
- NEW craftRentDue(G, craftId) → int $. It is rent × (min(t, monthEnd) − max(monthStart, craft.acquiredT)) / monthLength.
- Production stalls with the new reason 'storage': p.stalled = 'storage', plus a productionStalled {reason:'storage'} event, when the next unit's product would not fit after its materials leave the stores.
- When a bought craft arrives, craft.acquiredT is set to its purchase time.

OV.Economy:
- baseUpkeep(G, base).crafts and .total include base.rentDue.
- monthEnd charges rentDue, then resets base.rentDue to 0 on every base.

OV.Campaign.addCraft: craft.acquiredT = G.t. newCampaign: base.rentDue = 0.

OV.Save.fromJSON repairs base.rentDue (to 0) and craft.acquiredT (to null; null means the month start).

Data and tuning:
- Data.manufacture[*].cost raised on 14 items; the old value is kept as costOrig.
- TUNE.MANUFACTURE_PROFIT_CAP_H = 100.
- TUNE.MUZZLE_FLASH_LIGHT = 6.
- TUNE.AI_GRENADE_FUSE = [1, 0, 0].

tools/sim.js:
- battle --landed 0|1 and --novice (a beginner X-COM profile).
- runBattle(o) takes o.onEvent(B, ev) and o.novice.
summary:
I re-checked all 8 sim/data findings in r1_fixS.json. All 8 are fixed at the root, and each has a regression test in tools/tests/sim_persona_r1.test.js (9 tests). `node tools/test.js --strict --i18n` passes 635 tests with 0 failures. The only missing key it reports is nao.existe.x, which is the deliberate probe in another test.

Per finding:
1. **Kneel reserve (Rui): FIXED.** A walk always stands the soldier up, so «reservar para ajoelhar» now keeps the 4 TU even when the walk starts kneeling. validate, perform and walkPreview use the same reserve. The test is Rui's case: kneel, walk with the snap and kneel reserves on, then kneel again with the snap still reserved.
2. **Recruta first mission, landed UFOs, grenades (Sofia): FIXED in the sim.** There are two levers.
   - **Muzzle flash, in every month.** A shot fired from a dark tile lights the shooter's tile until that side's next turn, so the shooter can be seen and shot back. At night, 78 % of alien shots had come from shooters X-COM could not see.
   - **Alien grenades on Recruta use fuse 1.** The grenade lands during the alien turn and explodes at the end of the X-COM turn, so a beginner can scatter. Deaths of a clumped beginner squad to grenades fell from 34 to 10.
   - Battle sweep, Recruta, month 0, 10 rookies, the bot as X-COM, before → after:

     | Recruta, month 0 | Before | After |
     |---|---|---|
     | Medium Scout, night | 75–92 % | 96–100 % |
     | Large Scout, night | 75–79 % | 100 % |
     | Day | 92–100 % | 92–100 % |

   - With the new `--novice` profile (clumped, no kneeling, no grenades or flares): Medium Scout night 67–75 % → 92 %, Large Scout night 54–63 % → 79–83 %.
   - I did not script the first UFO; the UI hints the persona asked for are in open_issues.
3. **Blaster Launcher (Tiago): FIXED.** It is now validated with `Path.flyRoute` and fails only with the new reason `noRoute`. `validate` returns `route` for the UI preview. The alien AI still fires it only with a line of fire. With routes, the month-3 Veterano alien base fell from 54 % to 38 % wins over 24 seeds, so I kept the old AI rule.
4. **Manufacture profit (Inês): FIXED.** Profit is capped at 100 $ per engineer-hour; the original's best is the Laser Cannon at 97. Costs went up on 14 items, for example Laser Rifle 20 000 → 29 000, Motion Scanner 34 000 → 41 500, Personal Armour 22 000 → 25 000. Sale prices and alien loot are unchanged. The persona's script (10 engineers on Motion Scanners for 90 days) now gains +2.7 M$ over doing nothing; it was +6.0 M$.
5. **Month-0 night spike: FIXED by the muzzle flash.** Veterano month 0, before → after:

   | Veterano, month 0, night | Before | After |
   |---|---|---|
   | Medium Scout | 75 % | 96–100 % |
   | Large Scout | 58–83 % | 92 % |

   Both are above the 75 % target. Night battles in later months also improve, for example Large Scout 42 → 92 % and Battleship 33 → 75 %. The day sweep (`--ufo all`) is identical before and after.
6. **Craft rent exploit: FIXED.** A sold craft pays the rent for the time it was held this month, counted from its purchase for bought crafts. The amount goes to `base.rentDue` and is charged with the month-end upkeep. The persona's sell/rebuy cycle now ends at 13.71 M$ against 14.58 M$ without it; before it reached 17.28 M$.
7. **Power-source kills (Inês): FIXED.** Aliens killed by the crashed UFO's power sources before turn 1 count as crash deaths, with no kill line and no points.
8. **Manufacture vs storage: FIXED.** Production stalls with reason `storage` when the next unit would not fit, and resumes on its own when there is room. The persona's script now stops at 49.8/50; before it reached 72/50.

Campaign sweep, `node tools/sim.js campaign --seeds 6 --diff 0,1 --days 240 --det` (exit 0, deterministic):

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Recruta wins | 4/6 (67 %) | 5/6 (83 %) |
| Veterano wins | 3/6 (50 %) | 4/6 (67 %) |
| Cydonia wins | 80 / 60 % | 100 / 100 % |
| Council defeats | 0 | 0 |

deviations: Muzzle flash, in all months (TUNE.MUZZLE_FLASH_LIGHT 6, B.flashes). This is a new rule, not in the original. I chose it over a reduced alien night vision: I tried limiting alien sight in the dark to 12 tiles in month 0, and it changed nothing, because squads walk into the light of their own flares. Documented in DESIGN §22.
Recruta alien grenades use fuse 1 (TUNE.AI_GRENADE_FUSE [1,0,0]). This is ours.

Blaster Launcher: the player's guided bomb is validated by its flight route, but the alien AI still needs a line of fire to fire it. With routes, the month-3 Veterano alien base fell from 54 % to 38 % wins.

The manufacture profit is fixed by raising the costs of 14 items (costOrig is kept), not by lowering sale prices, so the income from selling alien loot is unchanged. The cap is 100 $ per engineer-hour, the original's best item, not a per-item original ratio.
Craft rent: a sold craft pays prorated rent, charged at month end through base.rentDue. Crafts that are kept still pay the full month, as in the original.

Recruta first mission: I did not script the first UFO to be a Small or Medium Scout that is shot down by day. The sim levers above bring a Recruta squad's first-mission wins to at least 92 % with the bot, and 79–96 % with the novice profile. The popup and briefing hints are UI work (open_issues).
The regression checks are Node tests only. I created no qa/*.mjs file, because qa/ belongs to the other fixers.
